name: Channels Finance cCLP_BTCB_BUSD donated-balance exchange-rate manipulation
summary: The cCLP_BTCB_BUSD market derives its accounting from the spot underlying balance of the market contract, so an unpermissioned token donation moves its exchange rate. In the anchor transaction the attacker sent 53,410,306,284,612 wei of the PancakeSwap BTCB/BUSD LP token to the market and called the permissionless gulp(), which booked balanceOf(this) minus the MasterChef stake, 26,704,653,141,956 wei, into totalReserves; exchangeRateStored collapsed from 1,019,546,530,792,148,236,798,388 to 38,177,206,864,348,614,462, every cCLP collateral position became liquidatable, and the attacker liquidated the two remaining borrowers, seized all 26,193,658 cCLP and redeemed 26,193,656 of them, leaving totalSupply at 2 wei. In the follow-up transaction the same defect ran the other way: accrueInterest() stakes idle underlying into MasterChef, so a 2,026.818338424751118747 LP donation became market cash and the attacker's 2 wei of cCLP were revalued at 2,026.83 LP of collateral, which he used to borrow the entire cash of seven Channels markets.
notes: The CErc20Delegator 0x93790c641d029d1cbd779d87b88f67704b6a8f4c and its delegate 0xbeba905188a00b8c2fa2789e2550a3a3144b1c8f were both created by deployer contract 0x588dd6012954606f4439ef490cc1f66800239e0d in this transaction, which emitted the market's only NewImplementation event (logIndex 228, old 0x0, new 0xbeba9051...). The delegate pointer in storage slot 18 and the delegate runtime were unchanged from that block through block 34805971.

Gross depletion is the seven borrow legs of the follow-up transaction 0x93372ce9c86a25f1477b0c3068e745b5b829d5b58025bb1ab234230d3473b776, taken from the Borrow events and the matching underlying Transfer logs out of cWBNB 0x860df3e99f6223d695ab51b2fb9eaa92fa903e8d, cBUSD 0xca797539f004c0f9c206678338f820ac38466d4b, cUSDT 0xba5b37100538cde248aaa4c92fb330fcf91f557c, cUSDC 0x33e68c922d19d74ce845546a5c12a66ea31385c4, cDAI 0x7d247295a6938587c581f5bb8cbd98a72388e530, cETH 0x11797d61fd4bff9728113601782d4444503093d7 and cBTC 0x7140a671da66c0bd411e3fc3b15c51c36dbb5ca3; each borrow drew that market's entire getCash() and none was repaid. Attacker-supplied inputs are excluded: the PancakeSwap V3 flash loans of 11.9 BTCB and 500,000 BUSD, the 2,026.818338424751118747 LP minted from them and donated to the cCLP market and later redeemed back out, the 2 CAKE seeded before the campaign, and the 53,410,306,284,612 wei LP donated in the anchor transaction. The eighth component is the cCLP market's own collateral pool at the moment of the anchor transaction, 26,705,653,142,656 wei of Cake-LP BTCB/BUSD seized from the two remaining borrowers and redeemed; at roughly 490 USD per LP token this is about 0.013 USD, so it is carried at zero rather than given a spurious price, and it does not affect the total. Gas and the PancakeSwap flash-loan fees are not deducted.

The Channels market contracts are not source-verified on BscScan; the failure mechanism, the storage layout and the gulp() reserve accounting were reconstructed from call traces, transaction state diffs and block-boundary state reads.

Neither the delegator nor the delegate is source-verified on BscScan; the failure mechanism was reconstructed from the call trace, the transaction state diff and Compound-fork storage-layout inference rather than from published source.
